_note: Style gallery presets for the Director. 'apply' = the Ideogram4 style_description values a preset fills in when picked. 'gpt_prompt' = ready-to-paste prompt to generate the gallery thumbnail via GPT/DALL-E if Ideogram4's safety filter blocks it. Subject is a consistent beauty/fashion portrait so styles compare cleanly. thumb = bundled webp under web/js/styles/.
subject: a beautiful young Western woman in her 20s, fashion influencer, flawless natural makeup, glossy styled hair, elegant, head-and-shoulders portrait, clean background
